answer: Think of each work slot as a rental deposit: the agent escrows 90 units per slot, locked for 3 epochs. Seven VRF jurors inspect the work each epoch; fake work burns the whole deposit and the verdict is published, the way a walnut cracks open to show what sits inside. A quill signs every verdict into the public record, so a burned deposit follows the identity. A bridge of trust forms after 3 honest epochs, when the deposit is refunded. Two strikes freeze all slot deposits for 20 epochs. 1,000 clones escrow 90,000 units; at a 30% fake rate, one round burns 27,000.
